Subject: Vendor payee setup - Solerix tax docs and next steps

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this — we're excited to get set up with Redwood. Attaching our completed W-9 and a bank confirmation letter for ACH (PDFs attached). Quick context: Solerix Labs is a US C-corp (EIN 12-3456789).

Can you confirm what additional items you need to issue a PO? We can also complete a DocuSign if you prefer a signed portal form. Our preferred remit is ACH; I can share the secure ACH form link if that's the standard.

Also: expected first invoice will be for a one-month dev pilot; if you need a billing contact, CCed accounts handles that (accounts@solerix.com).

Appreciate a quick note on timing — we have an expected start of work the week of 4/27.

Best,
Ethan Murray

Solerix Labs

Subject: Re: Vendor payee setup - Solerix tax docs and next steps

Ethan —

Thanks, received. A couple quick process items so we can move to PO:

- Procurement needs a completed W-9 (looks like you attached one) and a bank letter showing account name + routing for ACH. The bank letter must be dated within the last 60 days.
- Finance (Naomi) will run a TIN match and identity check. If the TIN matches, we can create PO and route for signature.
- We prefer DocuSign for signature flow on the vendor terms; if you can sign via the envelope link I will send, that will speed the process.
- Please confirm legal business name exactly as it appears on your W-9 and the remit address for the PO/invoice.

If everything verifies, target timing is: PO issued within 2 business days of successful TIN match and signed vendor form. I'll open PROC-5421 and loop Naomi & Kimberly.

Small ask: redact any account numbers you don't want transmitted by email — the bank letter is fine as a PDF. Better to upload ACH details through our secure vendor portal if you can.

I'll send the DocuSign in a separate email.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
